# Agentic UI — AI Components Index

> Scoped index for AI-native UI only. Load this when the task is an AI-generated or agent-driven surface.
>
> **Rules:** [/design-system/rules/ai-interaction.json](../../rules/ai-interaction.json) · **Tokens:** [/design-system/tokens/semantic.json](../../tokens/semantic.json) · **Parent:** [agent-instructions.md](../agent-instructions.md)

---

## Before anything else

The `ai:*` namespace is not a style. These components carry signals — the AI accent, the soft surface, the attribution header — that tell a user **a machine produced this**.

- Using them on human-authored UI falsely attributes it to a machine.
- Using `ui:*` for AI output hides authorship.

Both are violations. See [`FORBID_AI_IN_STANDARD_UI`](../../rules/forbidden.json).

## Load order

1. [/design-system/rules/ai-interaction.json](../../rules/ai-interaction.json) — experience modes, behaviors, accountability obligations
2. [/design-system/tokens/semantic.json](../../tokens/semantic.json) — the `--ai-*` scale
3. The component folders below — prompt, then contract, then spec
4. [/design-system/patterns/ai-approval-flow.json](../../patterns/ai-approval-flow.json) and [ai-response.json](../../patterns/ai-response.json) — composition sequences

## Experience metadata

Every component below declares how much autonomy it grants the machine and what it owes the human in return. **Match the component to the actual autonomy being granted.** Do not reach for an Approve-level component when the interaction is a suggestion, or the reverse.

| Behavior | What the machine may do | What it then owes |
|---|---|---|
| Suggest | Propose. No state changes. | Attribution |
| Confirm | Ask before proceeding. Blocking. | Attribution, Approval |
| Apply | Execute a change. | Approval, Audit trail, Reversibility |
| Approve | Act on the human's behalf. | All of the above, explicitly consented |

---

## Components

### Approve / Apply

These change state. Every one requires a human gesture and owes an audit trail.

| Component | Status | Intent | Accountability |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`ai:ai-action`](ai-action/ai-action.md) | beta | The decision point at the end of every AI recommendation. Primary confirms, secondary reviews, tertiary dismisses. | Attribution, Approval, Audit trail, Rationale disclosure |
| [`ai:ai-approval-card`](ai-approval-card/ai-approval-card.md) | beta | A consequential proposal, and the human decision about it, in an order that cannot be got wrong. | Attribution, Rationale disclosure, Confidence signalling, Approval, Audit trail, Reversibility |
| [`ai:ai-button`](ai-button/ai-button.md) | stable | Commit to something a machine proposed. | Attribution, Approval |
| [`ai:ai-control-bar`](ai-control-bar/ai-control-bar.md) | stable | The human can always stop the machine. | Attribution, Approval, Audit trail, Reversibility |
| [`ai:ai-message-footer`](ai-message-footer/ai-message-footer.md) | stable | Where the user says yes to what the response offered. | Attribution, Approval |

### Suggest

These change nothing. They inform, attribute, or disclose.

| Component | Status | Intent | Accountability |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`ai:ai-agent-stack`](ai-agent-stack/ai-agent-stack.md) | stable | Several agents working at once, and what each of them is doing. | Attribution, Audit trail |
| [`ai:ai-agent-work-note`](ai-agent-work-note/ai-agent-work-note.md) | draft | Show what the agent is doing without exposing raw reasoning. | Attribution, Rationale disclosure, Audit trail |
| [`ai:ai-avatar`](ai-avatar/ai-avatar.md) | stable | The mark that tells a user a machine is speaking. | Attribution |
| [`ai:ai-chip-brief`](ai-chip-brief/ai-chip-brief.md) | stable | Whether an agent task brief is ready to run — and whether a human still has to say yes. | Attribution, Approval |
| [`ai:ai-chip-handoff`](ai-chip-handoff/ai-chip-handoff.md) | stable | Show the moment accountability changed hands. | Attribution, Audit trail |
| [`ai:ai-chip-memory`](ai-chip-memory/ai-chip-memory.md) | stable | Tell the user when the system is drawing on something it learned earlier. | Attribution, Rationale disclosure, Audit trail |
| [`ai:ai-chip-quick`](ai-chip-quick/ai-chip-quick.md) | stable | Offer a starting point so the user does not face an empty box. | Attribution |
| [`ai:ai-confidence-risk-badge`](ai-confidence-risk-badge/ai-confidence-risk-badge.md) | stable | State how sure the model is and how much is at stake, before the human decides. | Attribution, Confidence signalling, Rationale disclosure |
| [`ai:ai-dialog`](ai-dialog/ai-dialog.md) | stable | Where the human writes to the machine. | Attribution |
| [`ai:ai-dialog-button`](ai-dialog-button/ai-dialog-button.md) | stable | A quiet control in the composer toolbar that does not compete with the message. | Attribution |
| [`ai:ai-feedback-bar`](ai-feedback-bar/ai-feedback-bar.md) | stable | Let the human correct the record. | Attribution |
| [`ai:ai-icon`](ai-icon/ai-icon.md) | beta | A treatment layer over standard icons — not a new icon set. | Attribution |
| [`ai:ai-launcher`](ai-launcher/ai-launcher.md) | stable | The way in. Recognisable, confident, never instructional. | Attribution |
| [`ai:ai-loading-indicators`](ai-loading-indicators/ai-loading-indicators.md) | stable | Say that the machine is working, truthfully. | Attribution |
| [`ai:ai-message-body`](ai-message-body/ai-message-body.md) | stable | AI prose, kept plain so the interface does not lend it authority the model has not earned. | Attribution |
| [`ai:ai-message-header`](ai-message-header/ai-message-header.md) | stable | Establish who is speaking before the user reads a word. | Attribution |
| [`ai:ai-progress`](ai-progress/ai-progress.md) | draft | Progress for work that can be blocked or escalated, not merely slow. | Attribution, Audit trail |
| [`ai:ai-queue-badge`](ai-queue-badge/ai-queue-badge.md) | stable | The state of one item in an agent queue, readable at a glance. | Attribution, Audit trail |
| [`ai:ai-response`](ai-response/ai-response.md) | stable | One AI turn, assembled so attribution, progress and recourse are present by construction. | Attribution, Rationale disclosure |
| [`ai:ai-soft-surface`](ai-soft-surface/ai-soft-surface.md) | beta | The wash that says everything inside this boundary was machine-generated. | Attribution |
| [`ai:ai-text-link`](ai-text-link/ai-text-link.md) | beta | An inline link inside AI prose whose label stands on its own. | Attribution, Rationale disclosure |
| [`ai:ai-why-this-link`](ai-why-this-link/ai-why-this-link.md) | stable | Make the reasoning reachable in one interaction. | Rationale disclosure, Attribution |

---

## Non-negotiable

- **Never auto-apply on render.** A human gesture is required for every Apply and Approve behavior.
- **Never render a confidence value the model did not produce.** Absent means absent, not high.
- **Never animate to simulate effort.** Loading indicators must track real in-flight work.
- **Never exceed three visible actions** in one decision row.
- **Never mix `--ai-*` tokens into standard product UI.**
- **Attribution comes before the body**, never after.

Full set: [/design-system/rules/ai-interaction.json](../../rules/ai-interaction.json)
